steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). After signing in, confirm you are logged in and report what page you land on.

02-find: Go to the Opportunities list (left navigation > Opportunities). Find all opportunities whose Name starts with 'Seed:' and report each name exactly as shown in the list, one per line. If the list is paginated or has more rows than fit, make sure you see all of them (use the search/filter or pagination as needed). Report only the names, nothing else.

03-create: Create a new Opportunity in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = the account named exactly 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — type it and pick the record named exactly 'Bench Account' from the suggestions or the select dialog, so the link is actually set; other accounts have similar names, choose only the exact one); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500 (leave currency as the default); Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = the user named exactly 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — choose the actual record 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions/select dialog, not just typed text); Description = 'Bench opportunity for run {{runid}}'. Save the record. Then open the saved opportunity's own page and report: the name shown, the account shown, the stage, the amount, the close date, the assigned user, and the URL of the page.

04-open: Open the opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' (its detail page). I need to verify the exact stored Close Date. Click the pencil/edit icon on the Close Date field so it becomes editable in place, and report the exact value shown in the date input (including the year). Then close/cancel that inline editor WITHOUT saving, so the record is unchanged. Also report the value shown in the Amount field if it is visible in the same inline edit, and confirm the record was not modified (no save happened).

05-find: On the detail page of the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' ({{03-create.url}}), find the {{01-signin.landing_heading}} panel and post a new message whose text includes the runid '{{runid}}' — for example: 'Bench stream post for run {{runid}}'. Submit the post. Then verify the post appears in the {{01-signin.landing_heading}} on that page and report the exact text of the post as displayed, and who posted it.

06-open: Open the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' detail page and do a final read-only verification. Report, from the page itself: (1) the record Name, (2) the Account name shown, (3) the Stage, (4) the Amount with currency, (5) the Close Date, (6) the Assigned User, (7) whether the Description contains the text '{{runid}}', (8) whether the {{01-signin.landing_heading}} contains a post whose text includes '{{runid}}' (quote it), and (9) the full URL of the page including the record id after #Opportunity/view/. Do not change anything.
